scientific_scope: Reference-free implementation reachability only. Not response fitting, model selection, or biological validation.

exact_identity_panel.comparison: canonical locomotion vs P1 zero-dose, and canonical locomotion vs P1 kappa=0

structural: exact canonical x/y/heading/RNG/biology-state identity in zero-dose panel
exact canonical x/y/heading/RNG/biology-state identity in kappa=0 panel
no extra RNG streams or draws

pass_fail_rule.exact_identity: All 32 seeds must be bit-for-bit identical for zero-dose and kappa=0 comparisons on x, y, heading, biology RNG state, speedFactor, pauseRemaining, state, baseSpeed, turnScale, and pauseScale.
pass_fail_rule.invariances: All frozen analytic/local invariance checks must pass.
pass_fail_rule.attraction: Across the 400 matched-seed pooled panel, pheromone must have strictly greater mean central_zone_fraction AND strictly greater trail_axis_exit_rate than zero dose.
pass_fail_rule.moving_speed_dynamics: All 32 fixed-time matched seeds must have identical baseSpeed, speedFactor, pauseScale, turnScale, pauseRemaining, state, and biology RNG state between canonical and nonzero-dose P1; this demonstrates P1 does not modify the stochastic moving-speed/pause process.
pass_fail_rule.overall: PASS only if exact identity, invariances, attraction, moving-speed dynamics, reference firewall, and Y-maze firewall all pass.

failure_rule: If the first correctly implemented execution fails any frozen criterion, P1-v1 engineering values may not be tuned on that outcome. Only a genuine implementation or infrastructure defect may be corrected, with this execution policy and the mechanism freeze unchanged.
